intent: Make explicit the full finite family of group isomorphisms Z_12_v1 -> Phase_12_v1, to prevent silent promotion of one generator choice as canonical on the typed AX20/T162 lane.

meaning.statement: Each emb_u is a group isomorphism Z_12_v1 -> Phase_12_v1; there is no canonical choice of u exported on this lane.
meaning.aut_z12_identification: Aut(Z_12_v1) ≅ (Z/12Z)^× and acts by k ↦ u*k (mod 12).

hard_limits: Does not choose one embedding as canonical.
Does not claim quotient invariance of downstream constructions under Aut(Z_12_v1).
Does not export Berry/holonomy or density-operator ingredients.
Does not export theta_1/theta_2 and does not claim QW-2191 discharge nor ToE closure.
